name: Starbase Orbital Pad A
best_known_for: First Starship orbital flight test; designed for the full reusable Mars-bound stack
credit: Starship launch pad at Boca Chica / Starbase, Texas, 26°N. First integrated Starship flight test (IFT-1) on April 20, 2023 — vehicle loss at MaxQ but the pad survived the over-pressure event. Subsequent IFTs have demonstrated booster catch via the Mechazilla tower arms and increasing test-flight success across 2024-2025. Designed for the fully reusable Mars-bound Starship + Super Heavy stack at unprecedented cadence; the pad's water deluge system is the largest deployed for any orbital launch system. Coordinates from FAA + SpaceX public records.
